q: What carbon data should a Brazilian merchant pig iron exporter prepare for EU and US buyers?
title: Brazilian pig iron: buyer carbon data
short: For EU buyers, a verified CBAM figure per tonne under CN 7201, because pig iron is a covered good. For US and other mills, a cradle to gate product figure they can use in their own footprint and declarations. Both start from the same records: reductant, fuel, ore and production.
audience: Merchant pig iron exporters in Minas Gerais and Espirito Santo

ul: Direct embedded emissions per tonne, by installation, for each year.
The monitoring method and a verifier's report.
Biomass evidence if charcoal carbon is rated zero.
A cradle to gate figure per tonne, including electricity, ore and charcoal making.
The share of charcoal versus coke and the plantation evidence behind it.
The method used, such as ISO 14067.

p: Electric arc furnace mills charge pig iron to lift metal quality, and its figure flows into their steel. A low, well documented number is a reason to buy from you.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas and electricity invoices and production records into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so the direct emissions behind each tonne can be traced to the documents. Emissions factors outside India are entered from the official source and labelled.
